title: A Two-Dimensional Study of the Model Context Protocol: Publication and Adoption
abstract: arXiv:2609.14721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), released by Anthropic in November 2024, standardizes how large language model applications connect to external tools and data sources. Despite MCP's rapid growth, no study has jointly characterized its emergence in the research literature, its adoption on GitHub and the relationship between them. We address this gap with a longitudinal, two-dimensional study of 802 MCP-related publications and 33,319 GitHub repositories. We characterize their growth and identify their application domains via BERTopic and usage contexts via a human-validated GPT-5.6-Luna classifier. We find that publications and repositories began rapid growth within a month of each other in 2025, and peaked together in March 2026. Notably, a second growth wave alone accounts for 49.5% of the GitHub repositories. translated_title: 模型上下文协议的二维研究：学术发表与实际采用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.14721v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）由Anthropic于2024年11月发布，它标准化了大型语言模型应用连接外部工具和数据源的方式。尽管MCP增长迅速，但此前尚无研究共同刻画它在研究文献中的兴起、在GitHub上的采用情况以及两者之间的关系。我们通过对802篇MCP相关出版物和33,319个GitHub仓库进行纵向二维研究来填补这一空白。我们刻画了它们的增长态势，并通过BERTopic识别其应用领域，通过经过人工验证的GPT-5.6-Luna分类器识别其使用场景。我们发现，出版物和仓库在2025年彼此相差不到一个月的时间内相继开始快速增长，并于2026年3月同时达到峰值。值得注意的是，仅第二波增长就占GitHub仓库总数的49.5%。大多数出版物（57.8%）和几乎所有的仓库（93.7%）将MCP用作使能技术，而非用于分析、评估（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究首次通过对802篇学术出版物和33,319个GitHub仓库的纵向二维分析，共同刻画了模型上下文协议（MCP）在学术文献与开源社区中的发展轨迹，发现二者在2025年相继快速爆发并于2026年3月同时达到峰值，且绝大多数场景下MCP被用作使能技术。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first joint two-dimensional longitudinal analysis of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), characterizing its emergence in 802 publications and its adoption across 33,319 GitHub repositories, revealing that both began rapid growth within a month of each other in 2025, peaked together in March 2026, and are predominantly used as an enabling technology.
